findings.title: Missing HSTS header
findings.detail: Strict-Transport-Security is not set, so browsers may fall back to plain HTTP on the first visit.
findings.what_it_does_not_prove: Does not prove the site serves content over HTTP; may be behind a proxy that handles TLS.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
findings.detail: No CSP means injected scripts run freely. It is the strongest single defence against XSS.
findings.what_it_does_not_prove: Does not prove XSS vulnerabilities exist; CSP is a defense-in-depth measure.
findings.remediation: Implement a Content-Security-Policy header starting with 'default-src' restrictions.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
findings.detail: Without 'nosniff', browsers may MIME-sniff responses and execute unexpected content.
findings.what_it_does_not_prove: Does not prove content sniffing is being exploited; modern browsers have improved protections.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
findings.detail: URLs can leak to third parties through the Referer header.
findings.what_it_does_not_prove: Does not prove sensitive data is being leaked; depends on URL structure.

findings.title: No robots.txt
findings.detail: Search engines and bots have no guidance. Not a vulnerability on its own.
findings.what_it_does_not_prove: Does not indicate a security issue; many sites intentionally omit robots.txt.
findings.remediation: Create robots.txt if you want to guide search engine crawling behavior.

findings.title: No sitemap.xml
findings.detail: A sitemap helps search engines find your pages. Missing is normal for apps.
findings.what_it_does_not_prove: Does not indicate a security issue; many single-page apps intentionally omit sitemaps.
findings.remediation: Create sitemap.xml if you want to improve SEO for content pages.

findings.title: No security.txt
findings.detail: Researchers have no published way to report a vulnerability, so reports may go nowhere.
findings.what_it_does_not_prove: Does not indicate a security issue; you may handle reports through other channels.
findings.remediation: Create security.txt at /.well-known/security.txt with a Contact field.
